title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who is in the huddle
hook: Where are the parents during your post-game talk?
intro: You gather the team after the game.
Parents crowd in close to listen.
statement: Kids talk differently when parents are listening.
q1: Do you keep the huddle players only —
q2: or let parents hear what you say?
q3: What do kids share when it is just the team?
t1: Both can work. But the huddle feels like theirs
t2: when it is just the team and the coaches.
cta: Coaches — who is in your huddle?
ctaLines: Players only. Parents welcome. Parents a few steps back.
ctaPrompt: Share your huddle habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Where are the parents during your post-game talk?
You gather the team after the game. Parents crowd in close to listen.
Kids talk differently when parents are listening.
Players only or parents welcome. Both can work.
Who is in your huddle? Share your habit in the comments.
